notes: Mermaid .. is non-identifying relationship, not proof that an FK is absent; read FK/LOGICAL labels.
The ORM property meta maps to SQL column metadata.
All UUID columns use SQLAlchemy Uuid; concrete database storage differs by dialect.
Timestamp tz denotes timezone=True in the declaration; database-specific behavior still applies.
Nullable unique repo_id in thread_memories does not imply a single NULL row on all databases.
JSON fields can contain additional associations not expanded as SQL tables.
ModelProviderSelection and ChatFeedback declare ON DELETE actions. Read ORM cascades and application cleanup separately.
All 36 ORM tables are represented; bridges repeat PKs for cross-domain navigation.

ER render direction is controlled by er.layoutDirection; legacy parser does not support direction syntax. ChatMessage to ChatSession combines two logical field references on one rendered edge; the logical_relations list retains both source associations.

notes: documents 保存文本片段和 metadata。向量由配置的 Milvus 或同一个业务 PostgreSQL 中的 pgvector 表保存。
pgvector 表在首次写入时按需创建，属于运行时 DDL，不计入 ORM 表总数。
documents.source_type + source_id 是多态来源，knowledge_file 时可指向上传文档。
knowledge_graph_edges 的 from/to 端点为应用层多态标识，可能对应文档组或文件，不是 FK。
eval_runs 无 repo_id 列，RAG 任务的仓库范围和状态存放在 result_json。
